bug_semantics: Express Entry Detail block action_view_express_entity($exEntryID) loaded a Concrete\Core\Entity\Express\Entry by sequential primary key (entityManager->find(Entry::class, $exEntryID)) with no per-entry authorization. The only gate was that the loaded entry's entity UUID equaled the block's configured exEntityID. Express Entry List links put that sequential getId() into /view_express_entity/{id}, so a visitor to a page hosting the block could enumerate integers and read every Express form submission for that entity (CWE-639 IDOR).
flaw_origin: The IDOR was first written on 2016-05-11 in e6a4e05418afa0be7206790a9d38e820202eb1b3 (Andrew Embler), which added action_view_express_entity as a Doctrine find-by-PK of Express\Entry plus a same-entity equality check, with no Permission\Checker and no non-sequential public identifier. The parent tree still had a document-library-copied controller and no such action. That lookup remained the public-history mechanism through 9.5.0 (syntax-only rewrites; 2025-08-25 e7dbf850 restored Entry::class after a 2025-06-29 export/import typo used Entity::class). 9.5.1 switched lookup to ObjectManager::getEntryByPublicIdentifier and added canViewExpressEntries().

Immediate parent 2148c928 exists and was inspected: the controller file is present but action_view_express_entity and any Entry PK lookup are absent, so this is a first-write not a move. Later 2018–2025 edits only added SEO/canonical/PHP8/export-import; the 2025 Entity::class typo briefly broke the action and e7dbf850 restored the original sequential Entry lookup — a restore, not the BIC. 9.5.0 still has find(Entry::class, $exEntryID); 9.5.1 contains squash f22b9dff from PR #12920, whose member 766c732 ('Fix H1 3620490') is the direct patch (public identifier + canViewExpressEntries).
